veld-tq-balgevoel.naam: Ball mastery: sole rolls and drag-backs
veld-tq-balgevoel.uitleg: Everyone works in their own space with a ball. Roll the ball sideways back and forth with your sole, drag it back with your sole and push it forward again with the inside of your foot. Switch feet after a minute.
veld-tq-balgevoel.organisatie: Players spread out 3–4 m apart, each with a ball. The coach stands in front of the group and demonstrates.
coachpunten: Light on the balls of your feet, standing leg slightly bent
Sole on top of the ball, not against it
Look up as much as possible, not only at the ball
Practise with both left and right

moeilijker: Faster, switching on a signal
Drag back and turn straight away
Combination: sole, inside, outside in one smooth sequence

veld-tq-aannemen-meenemen.naam: Receive and go through a gate
veld-tq-aannemen-meenemen.uitleg: A passes to B. With their first touch, B takes the ball diagonally forwards through the left or right gate behind them, turns and passes back. Then B picks the other gate. Swap roles after 6 goes.
veld-tq-aannemen-meenemen.organisatie: A and B stand 10 m apart. Behind B, 2.5 m to the left and right, is a gate of two disc cones (2 m wide).
coachpunten: Check over your shoulder before you receive: where is the space?
Receive with your back foot (stay open)
First touch firm enough to go straight through the gate

makkelijker: A rolls the ball by hand
moeilijker: A only calls 'left' or 'right' as they pass
Receive with the outside of the foot
An opponent behind B blocks one gate
After the gate, keep dribbling and finish on a mini goal

veld-tq-kappen-draaien.naam: Cuts and turns at the cone
veld-tq-kappen-draaien.uitleg: Dribble to the cone, turn just before it with a cut and accelerate back. A different turn each round: inside, outside, sole (drag-back) or Cruyff turn.
veld-tq-kappen-draaien.organisatie: An 8 m lane per player with a cone at the end; lanes 4 m apart. Everyone has a ball and starts at the same time.
coachpunten: Slow down with small steps just before the turn
Get low and keep your body between the ball and the cone
Accelerate straight after the turn: the first two metres matter most

makkelijker: Slow pace, turn at a line instead of a cone
moeilijker: The coach calls which turn
Against the clock: 4 times there and back
A defender behind the cone who may tag you after the turn

veld-tq-schijnbeweging.uitleg: Dribble at the pole (the 'defender'). At 1.5 m, feint to the right (body and leg go with it, the ball stays where it is) and accelerate past on the left. Jog back round the outside with the ball and rejoin the queue.
veld-tq-schijnbeweging.organisatie: A pole 5 m from the start, with the end cone 3.5 m behind it. Players queue, each with a ball. The next one goes when the player ahead has passed the pole.
coachpunten: Feint 1–2 m from the defender: not too early, not too late
Sell it: shoulder and hip really go with it
After the feint, push the ball away with the other foot and accelerate

makkelijker: Show the movement without a ball first
moeilijker: Step-over or double step-over
A real defender who may only move after the feint
Finish on a mini goal after beating the defender

veld-tq-poortjesdribbel.uitleg: There are small gates in the area. Dribble through as many different gates as you can in 45 seconds; the same gate twice in a row doesn't count. Who gets the most gates?
veld-tq-poortjesdribbel.organisatie: 16 × 16 m area with 6 gates of two disc cones (1.5 m wide), placed randomly. Everyone has a ball.
coachpunten: Look up and choose your next gate in advance
Slow down and turn just after the gate, then accelerate
Small touches in crowded areas, bigger touches in open space

moeilijker: Weaker foot only
A different turn after each gate
Two players without a ball may 'guard' gates
After five gates, pass to the coach and get it back into your path

veld-tq-hooghouden.uitleg: Keep the ball up as many times in a row as you can with your foot (and later thigh and head). Count out loud and try to beat your record. Young players may let the ball bounce once in between.
veld-tq-hooghouden.organisatie: Everyone has a ball, well spread out (3–4 m apart). Blocks of 1 minute with a short rest in between.
coachpunten: Strike the ball with your laces, ankle extended
Soft touch: the ball shouldn't go higher than your hip
Standing leg slightly bent, eyes on the ball

makkelijker: Drop the ball from your hands, touch it once and catch it again
moeilijker: Alternate left and right
Foot – thigh – foot – head
In pairs: take turns to touch it (keepy-ups together)
After ten keepy-ups, volley the ball at a mini goal

veld-tq-aannemen-uit-de-lucht.naam: Controlling the ball out of the air
veld-tq-aannemen-uit-de-lucht.uitleg: A throws the ball in an arc to B. B controls it out of the air (laces, thigh or chest), takes it a short way to the side and passes back along the ground. A varies the height. Swap roles after 8 goes.
veld-tq-aannemen-uit-de-lucht.organisatie: Pairs 6–7 m apart, one ball per pair.
coachpunten: Move towards the ball and read its flight early
Make the receiving surface 'soft': cushion it as you make contact
Take it in the direction you want to go

makkelijker: Let it bounce first, then control it
moeilijker: Take it to the side in one movement
A kicks the ball instead of throwing it
Volley or half-volley it straight back

veld-tq-indraaien.uitleg: The middle player comes short to A, receives the ball, opens up and turns towards C with one touch and passes to C. Then they come short to C, receive and turn again towards A. Change the middle player after 1 minute.
veld-tq-indraaien.organisatie: Three players in a line: A and C 20 m apart, the middle player halfway. A and C take turns to have the ball.
coachpunten: Move away from the ball first, then come short: that creates space
Check over your shoulder before you receive
Stay open and receive with your back foot

moeilijker: A passive defender behind the middle player
Turn with the outside of the foot
Play on straight after the turn (two touches in total)

veld-tq-koning-van-het-vak.uitleg: Everyone dribbles their own ball in the area. Protect your ball and meanwhile try to knock other players' balls out of the area. If your ball goes out, fetch it, do 5 keepy-ups or cuts outside the area and then join in again.
veld-tq-koning-van-het-vak.organisatie: 12 × 12 m area (smaller with fewer players). Everyone has a ball. Play in 1-minute blocks.
coachpunten: Body between opponent and ball (shield it)
Look up: where is the danger and where is a ball to win?
Ball close to your foot in crowded areas

makkelijker: One player without a ball is the 'hunter'
moeilijker: Smaller area
If you lose your ball you're out (last one left is king)
Dribble with your weaker foot only

veld-cv-aanname-lucht-schot.naam: Control out of the air, carry and shoot
veld-cv-aanname-lucht-schot.uitleg: The coach throws a high ball to the player. They control it out of the air, take it towards goal in the same movement and shoot within three touches.
veld-cv-aanname-lucht-schot.organisatie: Player 22 m from goal, coach diagonally in front at 6 m with balls. Keeper in goal. Alternate controlling with laces, thigh and chest.
coachpunten: Soft first touch: cushion the ball so it doesn't bounce away
Take the ball towards goal, don't stop it dead
Look up before you shoot: where is the keeper?

moeilijker: A defender behind you
Control and shot in two touches
Then a lay-off from the coach: first-time shot

veld-cv-rebounder-doeltjes.naam: Rebounder, turn and finish in a mini goal
veld-cv-rebounder-doeltjes.uitleg: The player passes against the rebounder twice, takes the second return with a turn away from the rebounder, dribbles to one of the two mini goals and scores.
veld-cv-rebounder-doeltjes.organisatie: Rebounder (or wall) 4 m from the player. Two mini goals 8 m behind them, left and right. The coach (or a teammate) calls which goal.
coachpunten: Pass with the inside of the foot, ankle locked
First touch on the turn: body open, take the ball towards the goal's side
Finish: place it, don't blast it

moeilijker: The coach only calls the goal during the first touch
A defender starts from the rebounder
Pass with left and right alternately

veld-te-kleurenreactie-bal.uitleg: Two players stand in the middle with a ball at their feet, facing the coach. The coach calls a colour; both players dribble as fast as they can to that disc cone, turn round it with the ball and dribble back to the middle. First back with the ball under control wins a point.
veld-te-kleurenreactie-bal.organisatie: Four coloured disc cones 4 m around a centre point (front, back, left, right). The players stand 1.5–2 m apart in the middle with a ball; the coach is 6 m in front of them.
coachpunten: Look up at the coach, not at the ball
Small touches as you slow down, ball close to your foot
Turn with the ball (inside or outside) and accelerate back

makkelijker: The coach also points to the colour (see and hear)
Dribble at walking pace first, then sprint
moeilijker: Weaker foot only
The coach calls two colours in a row
First back may shoot at a mini goal
